decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric sits close to the core offer and still has its own page, so keeping it is cheap, and two years are not yet enough to show that its value will not be realized.

The bouclé-effect sheer is only mentioned on the website and resembles the withdrawn bouclé leno, which raises the risk, but holding a partner-produced collection fabric costs little while its demand is still unclear.
Flame-retardant curtain fabrics serve contract and hospitality projects with long specification cycles, so the option keeps its value and costs little to hold.
The double-face wool blend fits the move toward renewable materials and has no clear negative signal yet, so it stays open while sales evidence accumulates.
The braided-structure fabric was launched only in 2024 and is presented on its own page, so its prospects are still highly uncertain and dropping it would be premature.
